description:
One server in full. Everything the server's page shows except the live player names: the full public record (see `/servers`)
read fresh, plus `votes`, `rating` (1-5 average) and `rating_count`, the last ten detected `wipes` (newest
first, with the seed/size before and after), `last_wipe_at`, `avg_wipe_cycle_hours` across those wipes,
`next_wipe_estimate_at` (last wipe + average cycle; a guess, not a schedule), `next_force_wipe_at` (Rust's
monthly forced wipe) and `map_preview` - null until a RustMaps render exists for the server's seed/size,
otherwise `image_url`, `thumbnail_url`, `total_monuments`, `monuments` (`{type, x, y}`), `monument_types`,
`land_percentage` and the five `biome_*` percentages. Offline servers still resolve; unknown ids are 404.
Player-count history is at `/servers/{id}/history`. Aggregates are cached for five minutes.

server_id.description: The server's numeric id (from `/servers`, or the number in its servers.rustprofit.com/server/{id} URL).

name: get_server
title: One server in full
